description: This source file implements a firmware cutter tool for Arcadyan W921V firmware images, extracting different parts such as LZMA compressed segments based on specific magic numbers and identifiers.

methods.name: part_type
methods.description: Determines the firmware part type based on an identifier, returning the corresponding filename for extraction.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that loads the firmware file, decrypts the header, searches for partitions, and extracts LZMA compressed segments.
